detail.reason: Published plan revision 13 and accepted ADR-016 in commit 6b12190, with current implementation status, exact-source gate evidence, and BR-T19 through BR-T22 transition items.

Verified and landed as dc4314a (pushed, HEAD==origin/main). Archive-context support was already at HEAD via f4f4df9 (require_vcs_checkout skip); this dispatch found and fixed a live defect the acceptance run exposed: the scratch assertions diffed all of ~/scratch, so a concurrent bead's extraction (beadrs-94fd9fc2-archive) failed the success run on 2026-09-04 while its own extraction was removed correctly, and the failure-path cleanup would have remove_dir_all'd that rival's dir. Both assertions now use the single path the script itself reports, so foreign traffic can neither fail the success run nor satisfy the failure run vacuously, and cleanup only touches the reported path. Verified against 6b12190 from an isolated clone with a private CARGO_TARGET_DIR and clean TMPDIR: real checkout 2/2 (125.69s, end-to-end release build); exact git-archive extraction 2/2 with both checkout-state assertions skipping explicitly on stdout+stderr; negative control (unreadable .git/HEAD with the marker present) fails at the rev-parse snapshot, exit 101, proving an archive-context skip cannot turn a real-checkout failure into a pass. HEAD/reflog/stash equality is asserted across both the success and injected-failure paths; the stash/reset/checkout violation classes all necessarily move HEAD or append the reflog, so the index and worktree are covered derivatively (strict worktree equality would false-fail on any rival's edit during the multi-minute build). Note: HEAD/index/worktree snapshotting is scoped to the three git-state surfaces by design, and the failed_archive_build_retains_scratch_dir + archive_build_leaves_shared_checkout_untouched pair now passes in both environments.

Landed as a4f8fbe (pushed, dc4314a..a4f8fbe on origin/main). Reopened the dc4314a close because its acceptance argument did not hold: it claimed 'the stash/reset/checkout violation classes all necessarily move HEAD or append the reflog, so the index and worktree are covered derivatively'. That is false for the harm class the 2026-09-01/02 incident actually caused. Demonstrated: after 'git checkout -- .' discarded a tracked modification, git rev-parse HEAD, git reflog and git stash list all read back byte-identical to before it ran (771c4f80/d630a501/e3b0c442 on both sides); 'git clean -fd' likewise deleted an untracked file with no movement on any of the three. A build script that erased a worker's uncommitted hour would still have passed the three-probe test. The scratch-assertion fix in dc4314a is kept unchanged (reported_scratch_dir + SCRATCH_REMOVED/SCRATCH_RETAINED). On top of it this lands two more snapshot surfaces -- 'git ls-files -s' for the index (mode+blob+stage per path, so staged-only tampering is visible) and 'git status --porcelain' for tracked worktree content plus untracked litter -- which is the acceptance clause the bead names explicitly. The worktree probe excludes .beads/, which every worker's bead mutations republish as a git-tracked side effect and which a build script cannot write; that exclusion is not hypothetical, it fired during verification (a rival's label_added on beadrs-94fd9fc2 at 07:14:08 republished the checkpoint mid-run and the excluded probe correctly still reported the run clean). Also makes the archive-context skip positive rather than inferred from .git absence: absence is also what a directory inside an enclosing repository looks like once git's upward discovery resolves the parent, where the probes would snapshot and the script would build from a checkout this test did not select; 'git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree' must agree there is nothing there, and disagreement panics. Adds BEADRS_ARCHIVE_TEST_CHECKOUT as an explicit fixture path and a third test asserting the classification. Verified from an isolated extraction of dc4314a with a private CARGO_TARGET_DIR and clean TMPDIR: real contended checkout 3/3 in 127s end-to-end release build with five-probe equality across both success and injected-failure paths; exact git-archive extraction 3/3 with all three assertions skipping loudly on stdout+stderr; exported tree nested inside a repository panics exit 101; .git marker present with unusable git 0/3 exit 101; each of the five probes separately proven to detect its own mutation class. rustfmt --edition 2024 clean on the file; zero clippy diagnostics on the test target.
